def err(c):
    ex=np.exp(-c*t**2)
    Q,_=np.linalg.qr(np.column_stack([ex,np.ones_like(t)]))
    ry=y-Q@(Q.T@y)
    RM=M-Q@(Q.T@M)
    nrm=np.sum(RM**2,0)+1e-30
    cors=(RM.T@ry)**2/nrm
    i=np.argmax(cors)
    # second: project RM[:,i]
    q=RM[:,i]/np.sqrt(nrm[i])
    ry2=ry-q*(q@ry)
    RM2=RM-np.outer(q,q@RM)
    nrm2=np.sum(RM2**2,0)+1e-30
    cors2=(RM2.T@ry2)**2/nrm2
    j=np.argmax(cors2)
    A=np.column_stack([ex,np.ones_like(t),M[:,i],M[:,j]])
    co=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((y-A@co)**2)/np.var(y), names[i], names[j], co
